_paper_reported.note: Numbers the paper (and its released code) report, kept unchanged. They come from the paper's own College Admission generator (2 features, group drawn independently of the features, tau = 0.5, one CGPR coin-flip draw) and from WoofNette images; the gym's scored experiments use an extended admissions world (hidden test, tau ~ U[0.6, 0.8], exact expected team accuracy), so these numbers are not on the gym's scale and are not results the gym must match. scripts/reproduce.sh still reproduces the College Admission sweep below on the paper's generator and writes the comparison to scoring/paper_reproduction.json.

college_admission_core.description: Synthetic College Admission CGPR team decision task at p=0.5, delta=0.25, alpha=0.9. Reference values are from the authors' released College Admission imperfect-human synthetic output for this setting.

college_admission_alpha_0_5.description: Synthetic College Admission imperfect-human setting at p=0.5, delta=0.25, alpha=0.5 from the authors' released alpha sweep.

college_admission_alpha_0_7.description: Synthetic College Admission imperfect-human setting at p=0.5, delta=0.25, alpha=0.7 from the authors' released alpha sweep.

college_admission_alpha_0_8.description: Synthetic College Admission imperfect-human setting at p=0.5, delta=0.25, alpha=0.8 from the authors' released alpha sweep.

college_admission_alpha_1_0.description: Synthetic College Admission imperfect-human setting at p=0.5, delta=0.25, alpha=1.0 from the authors' released alpha sweep.

admission_group_hidden.description: Admissions world, group membership NOT given at test time (only applicant features); confident-human accuracy ~0.90. The paper's practical setting: the AI cannot observe the human's confidence or group and must infer where to align and where to complement. Results: the gym's reference run on the hidden test (20,000 rows; no paper number exists for this extended setting, the paper's own numbers are kept under _paper_reported).

team_accuracy.description: Expected accuracy of the final human decision under the CGPR team model (tau ~ U[0.6, 0.8] per decision, reliance = agreement rate in the alignment region), computed exactly over tau and the reliance coin.

reliance_probability.description: Constraint (trust): expected agreement between the AI recommendation and the confident human's own judgment, i.e. the probability that unsure humans follow the AI.

ai_accuracy.description: Diagnostic: standalone accuracy of the AI recommendations; not ranked.

complementary_region_accuracy.description: Diagnostic: AI accuracy weighted by the probability that the human is unsure (the region where advice can be taken); not ranked.

admission_group_hidden_low_reliability.description: Same as admission_group_hidden with less reliable confident humans (accuracy ~0.75, lower and more variable confidence). Results: the gym's reference run on the hidden test (20,000 rows; no paper number exists for this extended setting, the paper's own numbers are kept under _paper_reported).
